stem.text: A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $6.0\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance is connected to a voltmeter and four other components, as shown.
The voltmeter is connected between points X and Y. The positive terminal of the voltmeter is connected to X and the negative terminal of the voltmeter is connected to Y.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a 6.0 V battery, a voltmeter V with its + and − terminals, points X and Y, a variable resistor, a thermistor, a light-dependent resistor and a fixed resistor.

stem.text: Initially, the resistance of each of the four components is $1.0\,\text{k}\Omega$.
Which change, on its own, will cause the voltmeter to show a positive reading?

A.text: Decrease the temperature of the thermistor.

B.text: Increase the resistance of the variable resistor.

C.text: Reduce the intensity of light incident on the light-dependent resistor (LDR).

D.text: Replace the fixed resistor with a $500\,\Omega$ resistor.
